/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/abal-fazl-e-bawafa.md\")
original = path.read_bytes()
start = b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\"
prefix, rest = original.split(start, 1)
roman_bytes, source = rest.split(b\"\\n---\\n\", 1)
roman = roman_bytes.decode()
for old, new in {
    \"Abal Fazl-e-Bawafa Alamdar-e-Lashkaram\": \"Abal Fazl bawafa alamdaar-e-lashkaram\",
    \"Mah-e-Hashmi nasab Amir-e-Dilawaram\": \"Maah-e-Haashmi nasab amir-e-dilaawaram\",
    \"dil ka paasbaṅ\": \"dil ka paasbaṅ\",
    \"din ka paasbaṅ\": \"din ka paasbaaṅ\",
    \"shujaatoṅ\": \"shuja'atoṅ\",
    \"aasmaṅ\": \"aasmaaṅ\",
    \"Jalal tera al-aman\": \"Jalaal tera al-amaan\",
    \"sayebaṅ\": \"saybaaṅ\",
    \"gulbadan wiqar\": \"gulbadan waqaar\",
    \"teghzan\": \"tegh zan\",
    \"Amir-e-sabr ka akhi qarar\": \"Amir-e-sabr ka akhi qaraar\",
    \"shahadat\": \"shahaadat\",
    \"bhulegi dunya\": \"bhule gi duniya\",
    \"alam uncha\": \"alam unchaa\",
    \"bahr o bar \": \"bahr o barr \",
    \"jahaṅ\": \"jahaaṅ\",
    \"Falak pukara\": \"Falak pukaara\",
}.items():
    if old "'!= new:
        assert old in roman, old
        roman = roman.replace(old, new)
source_lines = source.decode().splitlines()
roman_lines = roman.splitlines()
assert [len(block.splitlines()) for block in roman.split("'"\\n\\n\")] == [len(block.splitlines()) for block in source.decode().strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")]
for left, right in zip(roman_lines, source_lines, strict=True):
    assert bool(left.strip()) == bool(right.strip())
    if left.strip().isdigit():
        assert int(left.strip()) == int(right)
assert all(char.isascii() or char in \"ṅṄ\" for char in roman)
updated = prefix + start + roman.encode() + b\"\\n---\\n\" + source
path.write_bytes(updated)
assert path.read_bytes() == updated
"

item.text:
Audited all 33 Roman verses against the Urdu in [abal-fazl-e-bawafa.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/workspaces/0606d92f63024e46a3da6a71319ce9a7/src/data/lyrics/abal-fazl-e-bawafa.md). Removed the unsupported izafat from the recurring refrain and corrected vowel spellings, word spacing, and capitalization. The Urdu text and metadata were preserved.

Verified verse and stanza alignment. Retained `Amm-e-Sakina` and `mara` where the Urdu spelling leaves the pronunciation open.
